MO§ES™ Governance v0.1.0 – Initial Release

- Introduces a constitutional multi-agent governance framework enforcing McHenry Conservation Law and strict mode/posture/role constraints.
- Mandatory action sequence with lineage verification, governance checks, and tamper-evident audit logging.
- Defines explicit roles (Primary, Secondary, Observer), operational modes (e.g., High Security, Creative), and posture constraints (SCOUT, DEFENSE, OFFENSE).
